text:
maria_ops: seeing a cluster-wide uptick in NVidia Xid 48 and 79 on rack-r12 tonight. started ~23:10 UTC, mostly on A10s running the embedder batch job. logs look like noisy PCIe/retry + occasional ECC warnings.
kevin_infra: can you paste the top-level error lines?
maria_ops: pasted excerpt below:
```
[2026-03-19T23:11:04Z] GPU0: Xid 48, PCIe retry timeout, nvlink err=0x4
[2026-03-19T23:11:04Z] GPU0: ECC single-bit correctable error count +1
[2026-03-19T23:11:05Z] GPU3: Xid 79, software decode error during attention kernel
```
ashley_ml: this aligns with a bump in large-batch embedder traffic from batch-runner-5 around the same time. they pushed a 4x batchsize change yesterday.
tariq_sre: tagging infra-bot to run nvml-health diag on the affected hosts and get PCI error counters. @infra-bot run diag rack-r12 hosts [r12-01,r12-02,r12-03]
infra-bot: diag started. will post results in ~30s.
kevin_infra: if NVML shows rising PCIe uncorrectable counters we should soft-drain the card and schedule a cold-reboot window. prefer draining one host at a time to avoid capacity pressure.
maria_ops: quick telemetry query: embedder large-batch p95 latency increased 30% on r12-*. errors correlate with high concurrency and >1024 token sequences. could be memory fragmentation + decode kernel sensitivity.
ashley_ml: interesting — model variant v2 uses a new fused-attn kernel. could be triggering rare code paths on A10 with larger seqs. i can roll back to v1 for batch-runner-5 to see if spike drops.
tariq_sre: infra-bot results: PCIe Tx CRC errors incrementing on r12-01 GPU0, ECC SB counters steady but not skyrocketing. kernel oops present on r12-03 GPU3 at 23:11. full output: ```r12-01 GPU0 pci_tx_crc=12 pci_rx_crc=0 ecc_sb=3 ecc_db=0
r12-03 GPU3 nvfaillog: decode_err=1 stacktrace=attention_kernel+0x2f
```
kevin_infra: plan proposal: 1) drain r12-01 GPU0 and reprovision jobs to spare pool, 2) rollback embedder to v1 on batch-runner-5 for r12 routing, 3) schedule cold reboot for r12-03 during maintenance window, 4) collect longer nvml traces for 48/79 patterns.
maria_ops: +1 to staged drain. also suggests adding a per-tenant batchsize cap (e.g., 2048 tokens / 512 batch) as a short-term guard.
ashley_ml: i'll trigger a canary rollback for batch-runner-5 targeted to r12 only. will monitor embeddings success rate and Xid counts. :eyes:
tariq_sre: i've created a ticket INF-7729 to track repairs and attach nvml traces. tagging hardware team for potential PCIe riser inspection if CRC continues.
kevin_infra: cost note — if we keep draining multiple cards and rely on burst capacity from Dedicated pools we'll burn reserved credits. ops: if repair looks prolonged we should evaluate temporary capacity scale-up vs degraded SLAs.
maria_ops: thanks — i'll run the drain now on r12-01 GPU0 and post updates.
maria_ops: drain complete, jobs relocated, Xid events for r12-01 stopped. r12-03 still emits occasional Xid79.
ashley_ml: can confirm rollback to v1 reduced Xid79 on canary nodes. looks promising.
tariq_sre: moving to monitor phase for 2h. will escalate to hardware ops if r12-03 persists after reboot.
kevin_infra: summary for ops email: short-term mitigation worked (drain + rollback), likely root causes: interaction of new fused-attn kernel + high-batch large-seq workloads exposing rare A10 NV kernel bug and marginal PCIe link health on r12-01. follow-ups: full PCIe riser inspection, collect kernel traces for vendor bug report, add batchsize caps and routing policy to avoid mixing large seq and fused-attn on susceptible cards.
maria_ops: copied to INF-7729 and slack #incidents if we need cross-team help. thanks team :thumbsup:
